title: ecbolium betonica
intro: Ecbolium betonica, commonly known as Betonica or Betonica, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium betonica include reducing pain and inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
